papers.title: DeepCrossAttention: Supercharging Transformer Residual Connections
papers.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v2 byline; Google Research coauthors include Kyriakos Axiotis, Gang Fu, MohammadHossein Bateni and Vahab Mirrokni.
papers.code_status: 固定v2全文与2026-11-23 Google官方博客未提供已核实的本篇作者代码仓库；未找到不等于作者从未发布。

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Section5:64 TPUs, batch2048, sequence128,500000steps,131Btokens; depth/width and C4/LM1B/ImageNet matrices.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Published full configuration, not a local timing estimate. Tiny QKV-routing component budget below30seconds per three seeds, no data/checkpoint/API downloads.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅验收低成本GRN-v3/QKV attention组件

papers.summary: 三套独立GRN-v3在深度历史上构造Q/K/V输入；只实现固定v2文字公式、first/middle-sum/last-k和小型因果attention，不是完整Transformer训练。2026-11-23 Google官方博客触发历史补录，不是11月新论文。

papers.title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
papers.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 byline; coauthors also list Oxford, Cambridge, Fudan, Wake Forest and City University of Hong Kong (Dongguan).
papers.code_status: 已核原作者仓库与固定Exponential修复源；本地只实现一族Rewrite组件，不是作者完整包。
papers.local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.foundation_models.stablekl import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.paper_configuration: Author repository:10.8GB frozen benchmark, CPU hours per configuration and a cluster for all53; downstream grids take CPU/GPU hours plus checkpoints.
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Read-only published configuration; no full benchmark/model/download probe. CPU Exponential Rewrite diagnostic budget below10seconds across three seeds is an estimate.
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅验收CPU Exponential稳定分解与解析梯度组件

papers.summary: 以直接rate差值和phi的Horner级数避免近等Exponential KL消去，显式解析梯度；仅普通有限参数范围CPU Rewrite，不宣称18分布、strict正确舍入、F.kl_div或logits全修复。
